explication: Claude Relay Service is a self-hosted, multi-account API relay with API-key access control and a web administration interface. The main workflow is: a client sends an authenticated model request; a provider route selects an eligible account; the relay contacts the upstream service and returns the response. Operators manage accounts and keys and inspect usage through the admin interface. The README documents additional provider and compatibility paths; sampled source confirms selected Gemini and OpenAI flows, but not every route-to-relay connection.
